### To the Four Winds of Heaven
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/four-winds-heaven
Passage: Zechariah 6:1-8
Points:
- The four chariots patrolling the earth demonstrate God's complete knowledge and sovereign rule over all world affairs.
- Surrounding regions to the north and south that historically endangered Israel are brought to peace and quiet under divine oversight.
- The vision provided immediate comfort to the returned Jewish exiles, assuring them that hostile opposition would be restrained while rebuilding the temple.
- For modern believers, the vision guarantees that the Lord restrains all adversaries so that Christ will successfully build His church.
